designer-initial.summary: Selected and audited a finite five-usage dispatch coordinator with exact 5/14/12/5 small-tier counts and one principal release-decision owner.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset represent the Request Registry's two owner-local state variables and its provisional event update plus final same-request MarkSubmitted commitment atomically without moving release authority out of the sole Dispatch Arbiter?

Can the exact fourteen semantic interactions be preserved while any library-required delegation or routing connections are separately justified and mapped as generated support, with the raw connection count reported?

Can owner-local contracts express the product-bearing active/completion types, both total case partitions, and equivalence among Release, MarkSubmitted, and committed Submitted state without central recomputation?
Can an independent bounded analyzer enumerate exactly 980,424 snapshots and execute all five scenario families without using copied Registry or Dispatch Arbiter predicates as its oracle?

model-review.summary: Remove redundant INT-03 and distinguish one semantic layer from AADL physical depth two; all five owners remain nonidentity and realizable.

findings.evidence: Original INT-03 sends ArrivalFact to PART-05 only for invalid-arrival notice priority, but QUAL-01 plus CASE-01 already makes every invalid present arrival produce RegistryOutcome.InvalidEvent, which reaches PART-05 on original INT-12 and determines the same CTRL-02 value. The fan-out therefore adds no distinct local derivation on any admissible evaluation.
findings.requested_change: Delete original INT-03, remove ArrivalFact from PART-05 inputs, renumber the remaining inventory to INT-01..INT-13, and update every 14-interaction metric/audit claim to 13; preserve all PARTs, MON/CTRL semantics, twelve cases, notice priority, and five scenarios.

findings.evidence: The trusted Isolette pattern uses System -> Process -> Thread containment, accepted factory-dispatch source uses that structure and passes HAMR gates, and run 20260812T035741Z-mining-threat-retreat-hard-r1-a5 records that HAMR rejected Threads directly under System and required a behavior-free Process. The selected exact depth-one-under-System claim is therefore not a valid physical AADL realization.
findings.requested_change: Declare one semantic responsibility layer but physical containment depth two beneath the explicit System root, add one generated-support Process with no semantic credit, and preserve the five PART owners and one weak semantic region.

findings.evidence: Extensional audit finds PART-01 performs a 17-to-10 validity classification, PART-02 owns state-dependent event/lifecycle transitions, PART-03 combines product and amount thresholds, PART-04 performs prioritized multi-input authorization, and PART-05 resolves competing registry/dispatch facts. None is a copy, bundle, rename, reroute, or bijective code translation.

After deleting original INT-03, the AADL-valid realization has 13 semantic interactions and 19 raw connections: six boundary interactions map to two delegation declarations each and seven inter-usage interactions map to one declaration each. Attribute-based records, composite state member access, In(...) pre-state constraints, multi-output contracts, and cyclic relational dependencies have current repository/tool precedents.
findings.requested_change: Record the 13-to-19 semantic/raw mapping, tag all twelve boundary delegation declarations as generated support, and keep support out of semantic and owner counts.

findings.evidence: The bounded domain arithmetic is exact: 89 valid owner states times 11,016 boundary combinations equals 980,424 snapshots. The current harness can execute this deterministic Node analysis and cross-check source hash, status, zero diagnostics, Boolean checks, and ownership evidence, provided the analyzer keeps an abstract evaluator separate from owner-local evaluators and makes no formal-proof claim.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved revised 5/13/12/5 baseline with redundant interaction removed and physical depth-two generated support made explicit.

model-generation.summary: Canonical SysML passed retained architecture/final gates and exhaustive 980,424-snapshot bounded analysis at the approved 5/13/12/5 baseline.

visualization.summary: Validated one-view system overview passed native, geometry, and complete traceability review.

designer-final.summary: Source, owner-local bounded semantics, Designer fidelity, and rendered presentation passed; executable evidence is not required and was not run.
